Synopsis

A seemingly innocent college freshman hides feelings far more complicated than simple love. When she discovers her boyfriend's infidelity, their relationship takes a dark and unexpected turn. Stripped of the upper hand, he gradually finds himself falling under her control, unable to escape her growing influence. As their romance begins anew amid anger, confusion, and shifting power dynamics, the balance between them changes completely. What once seemed like an ordinary relationship becomes a dangerous game of control, and neither of them can ever return to the way things were before.
